qualifications: Scott et al. (2001), page 1876 and Figure 3, report weighted least squares on observations from two runs. Only 21 digitized filled-symbol observations are available here; the open temperature-quenched point is excluded. Incomplete digitized coordinate error bars cause the generic row reader to omit both sigma arrays, so this reconstruction uses equal pressure weights. Its retained errors use residual-scaled covariance because no observation sigmas are supplied, even though the generic ledger records absolute_sigma=True. They are not recovered source weights or a source confidence interval. The original row array, run identities, weights, covariance and precise objective remain unavailable. The source coefficients and digitization are preserved; this finding does not show that the published EOS is incorrect.

fit.weighting: Equal pressure weights; incomplete plotted errors are not used as fit sigmas. Refit covariance is scaled by residual variance.
fit.covariance_convention: Residual-scaled inverse normal matrix; no measured sigma arrays supplied. The fitting API scales covariance in that case regardless of absolute_sigma.

qualifications: Conditional coefficient parity compares K0 and K0_prime at the published printed precision, with adopted V0=154.5678863704812 A^3 per conventional Fe3C cell (Z=4) held fixed. Published K0=161 +/-2 GPa and K0_prime=5.9 +/-0.2 are retained unchanged. V0 is adopted from the published calculated full-range curve, not a printed source coefficient or the ambient measurement. Its uncertainty and the original fixed/free V0 convention are unrecovered. Numerical coefficient agreement does not establish uncertainty agreement, author-workflow reproduction or physical validation.

The primary experimental dataset is all 19 numbered p1-p19 points from final Table S1, with published ruby pressures and reported widths, spanning 1.8-47.4 GPa at nominal 293 K. The recorded comparison uses equal pressure weights with V0 fixed and K0/K0_prime free. It gives K0=160.994011 +/-2.532193 GPa and K0_prime=5.919478 +/-0.240867, displayed as 161 +/-3 and 5.9 +/-0.2 at the paper precision. The K0 uncertainty is not reproduced: 2.532193 GPa rounds to 3, not the published 2 GPa. Covariance is inverse(J^T J)*SSE/(19-2), conditional on exact V0 and exact input volumes. Source coordinate widths are preserved but are not the weights in this comparison; source confidence and calibration covariance are unknown. The 22 digitized Figure 1 markers remain separate supplementary evidence, not the primary dataset. No ambient or p20-p22 point is added. For p16, the final source volume is 133.25 A^3, not the alternate SHELX cell 133.58 A^3. Published split fits remain audit-only.
This is a conditional coefficient comparison, not recovery of source confidence, calibration covariance or the author fitting workflow.

The diagnostic effective-variance objective treats printed pressure and volume widths as if independent standard errors; its unscaled inverse-JtJ covariance is conditional. Original residual direction, weights, covariance, confidence convention and fit project are unavailable. Fixed-V0 uncertainty and shared calibration errors are not propagated. Original ruby wavelengths and separate ruby/neon pressure arrays are missing, so the pressure averaging cannot be replayed. Original-scale published coefficients and observations are preserved; Litasov (2013) recalibrated comparison coefficients are not substituted. This is not author-workflow reproduction, magnetic-phase validation or a recommendation for extrapolation.
